title: Fig and the Big Pot
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ow, oi, ear

pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar standing inside an old wooden barn, hay bales stacked around.

pages.text: A big pot sits on the cart.
pages.illustration: A large clay pot sitting on top of a wooden cart inside the barn.

pages.text: Fig taps the pot. Fig can not tip it.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pushing against the big clay pot, straining, the pot not moving.

pages.text: Fig digs in. Fig can not tip it.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar bracing with all his legs against the pot, still unable to move it.
Fig the caterpillar calling out loudly from beside the cart.

pages.text: Ned is in the barn now.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling arriving through the barn doorway, walking towards Fig.

pages.text: Ned and Fig tip the pot. The pot turns!
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Fig the caterpillar pushing together, the big clay pot starting to turn on its side.

pages.text: Fig and Ned sit near the cart. Fig had fun.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar and Ned the duckling sitting together beside the cart, the pot now tipped safely on its side.
